1.          ETA Santa Cruz de Tenerife (regular updates requested, including 96, 48, 24, 12 hrs)

9.          Arrival and departure IMO Passengers List in PDF format duly signed and stamped ( to be sent 96 hours min. before arrival date)

10.       Arrival and departure Excel format crew list (attached example of filling in)(pls do not change the formats and fill in all columns highlighted in blue

11.       Arrival and departure Excel format passenger list (same structure as excel format crew list)

12.       Crew and passenger list nationality breakdown in PDF format duly signed & stamped

13.       Crew and passengers transit list in PDF format duly signed & stamped

14.       Crew and passengers embarking / disembarking list

15.       ISPS notification + 10 last ports (Attached form of filling in) (note as per new regulation Port/Pier Facility Gisis Code must be included)

16.       Residues ANEX II (thanks to fill in the attached form, stamp, sing and send in PDF format)

17.       Residues List TNF Waste Template (Attached form of filling in, pls do not change any format and note there are 2 tabs) 

18.       Copy of the P&I Certificate of Entry

19.       Copy of the ISSC Certificate

20.       Copy of the Register Certificate

21.       Copy of the Bunker Insurance Certificate (CLC) (of the FLAG)

22.       Copy of the International Tonnage Certificate (ITC)

26.       Copy of the Garbage record book (10 last disposals)

CREW:            Passport copies and full flight itineraries for all on-signing and/or off-signing crew for immigration purposes to make the arrangements needed.
